# Vercel pricing: how it works and what you can learn

How Vercel charges customers in 2026, what it meters, what changed recently, and what any subscription business can borrow from it.

![](/assets/img/robert-coorey-160.webp)By [Robert Coorey](https://www.subscriptionplaybook.com/about/) Updated 27 October 2026 2 min read

**At a glance**

Vercel. Pricing model: Hybrid (base + usage). Value metric: Per-user subscription with dollar credits consumed at per-model token rates; Platform fee per deploying seat plus included usage credit; usage-based compute; Flat Rate CDN tiers.

## At a glance

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| Company | Vercel |
| What it does | v0  |
| Pricing model | Hybrid (base + usage) |
| Value metric | Per-user subscription with dollar credits consumed at per-model token rates; Platform fee per deploying seat plus included usage credit; usage-based compute; Flat Rate CDN tiers |
| Free tier | Free: $5 one-time credits for new users, 7 messages/day.; Hobby: free (non-commercial), 100 GB transfer, 1M edge requests, 4 hours Active CPU, 500 AI Gateway requests. |
| Pricing page | [v0.app/pricing](https://v0.app/pricing) · [vercel.com/pricing](https://vercel.com/pricing) |

## Plans and prices

Prices as published on Vercel's pricing page, checked 27 October 2026. They change often; check the live page before you rely on them.

### v0

| Plan | Price | Billing | What you get |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Plus** | $30 (shown struck from $90) | per user per month | $30 monthly credits + $2 daily login credits |
| **Business** | $100 | per user per month | $30 monthly credits + $2 daily credits; team features |
| **Enterprise** | Custom | annual |     |

**Usage component.** Model rates per 1M tokens: v0 Mini $0.20 in / $1.20 out; v0 Pro $2 / $10; v0 Max $5 / $25; v0 Max Fast $10 / $50.

**How credits/tokens work.** Additional credits can be purchased and shared across a team.

### Vercel platform

| Plan | Price | Billing | What you get |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Pro** | $20 | per deploying seat per month | $20 included usage credit; free viewer seats; Flat Rate CDN default for new teams |
| **Flat Rate CDN tiers** | $20 (10M requests/50 TB) / $100 (50M) / $300 (150M) | per month | No overage from traffic spikes |
| **Enterprise** | Custom | annual |     |

**Usage component.** Active CPU from $0.128/hour; function invocations $0.60 per 1M; AI Gateway $3 per 1,000 token requests; triggers $0.95 per 1,000. On-demand CDN from $0.15/GB and $2 per 1M requests.

**How credits/tokens work.** $20 monthly credit applies across resources; pay as you go uncapped beyond it.

## What changed in 2025–2026

2025: moved to token-based credits by model. Plus displayed at $30 against a struck-through $90 at time of checking.

Sep 2025: Pro restructured to a $20 platform fee with one deploying seat and $20 usage credit; free viewer seats. 8 Sep 2026: Flat Rate CDN generally available, default for new Pro teams, after customers asked for predictable bills.

## What you can steal

1.  ### [Pricing](https://www.subscriptionplaybook.com/pricing/)
    
    v0 publishes its own model token rates, effectively reselling inference with a markup and a UX layer. That is honest cost-plus, and it caps how much value the vendor can capture.
    
2.  ### [Pricing](https://www.subscriptionplaybook.com/pricing/)
    
    Vercel moved part of its bill back from usage to flat tiers because customers feared traffic-spike bills. Offer a flat tier for the spiky, scary meter.

Vercel v0 Pricing: Plans, Credits & Limits (2026 Guide) | UI Bakery Blog ###### Table of contents [This is also a heading ](https://uibakery.io/blog/vercel-v0-pricing-explained-what-you-get-and-how-it-compares#)[This is also a heading ](https://uibakery.io/blog/vercel-v0-pricing-explained-what-you-get-and-how-it-compares#)[This is a heading ](https://uibakery.io/blog/vercel-v0-pricing-explained-what-you-get-and-how-it-compares#)[This is a heading ](https://uibakery.io/blog/vercel-v0-pricing-explained-what-you-get-and-how-it-compares#) ![Vercel v0 Pricing: Plans, Credits & Limits (2026 Guide)](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6542d8f9e468531067fe9978/687a870a5d8a0a1bcd966e61_blocks-staying-near-each-other-2-min.webp) Articles 4 min # Vercel v0 Pricing: Plans, Credits & Limits (2026 Guide) ![Dora Gurova](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6542d8f9e468531067fe9978/66d702f28b59ddf299485dd1_IMG_4991.jpg) By [Dora Gurova](https://uibakery.io/blog-authors/dora-gurova) Updated: June 6, 2025 Vercel v0 has four plans: \- \*\***Free**\*\* — $5 in monthly credits, access to v0-1.5-md, deploy to Vercel \- \*\***Pro**\*\* — $20/user/month, $20 in credits, v0-1.5-lg, Figma import, v0 API \- \*\***Team**\*\* — $30/user/month, $30 in credits per user, shared billing, v0 API \- \*\***Enterprise**\*\* — custom pricing, SAML SSO, training opt-out, priority access Additional credits can be purchased on Pro and Team plans beyond the monthly allowance. [Vercel v0](https://uibakery.io/blog/what-is-vercel-ai) is an AI-powered frontend generator built by the team behind Vercel and Next.js. It lets developers generate Tailwind + React components from plain English prompts — and deploy them instantly to Vercel. This 2026 guide breaks down v0's current pricing plans, credit limits, and how it compares to alternatives like [UI Bakery](https://uibakery.io/), [Lovable AI](https://uibakery.io/blog/what-is-lovable-ai), and [Bolt AI](https://uibakery.io/blog/what-is-bolt-ai). Let’s break it down. ## Vercel AI Pricing | Plan | Cost | Key Inclusions | | --- | --- | --- | | Free | $0 | For people looking to explore.
$5 of included monthly credits
Deploy apps to Vercel
Access to v0-1.5-md
Sync with GitHub | | Pro (Vercel) | $20/user/month | For higher limits and power users.
$20 of included monthly credits

5× higher attachment size limit
Import from Figma
Access to v0-1.5-lg
Access to v0 API | | Team | $30/user/month | For fast-moving teams and collaboration.
$30 of included monthly credits per user
Purchase additional credits outside of your monthly usage shared across your team

Access to v0 API | | Enterprise | Custom by request | For large companies that require additional security.

Priority access for better performance and no queues
Dedicated customer support
Access to v0 API | ## Vercel v0 Free Plan: Credits & Limits Explained The free tier includes \*\*$5 in monthly credits\*\*, which resets each billing cycle. Credits are consumed per generation — more complex prompts and larger model usage draw down credits faster. **Key limits on the Free plan:** \- Model access: v0-1.5-md only (not the larger v0-1.5-lg) \- Attachment size: standard limit (5× smaller than Pro) \- No Figma import \- No access to the v0 API \- No team collaboration features Once your $5 in credits is used, you can upgrade to Pro for $20/month to get more credits and unlock higher-tier model access. Pro and Team users can also \*\*purchase additional credits\*\* if they exceed their monthly allowance. ## Vercel v0 pricing: best use cases ### 1\. Free tier You can use v0 completely free if you just want to generate React + Tailwind components based on prompts. There are no usage limits currently imposed on basic generation. **Best use case:** perfect for solo developers or designers who want to quickly sketch out a UI without coding it from scratch. For example, a junior dev might use v0 to instantly scaffold a login screen or dashboard component for their portfolio. ### 2\. Premium tier ($20/user/month) This is the standard Vercel Pro plan, which enhances the v0 experience by adding collaborative tools, CI/CD, preview deployments, analytics, and custom domains. **Best use case:** a small team building a Next.js app that uses v0 to generate UI components. They collaborate using preview links, push to GitHub, and auto-deploy to staging—all within Vercel. Think of a startup creating a pricing page or admin panel in days instead of weeks. ### 3\. Team & Enterprise (Custom pricing) At the enterprise level, v0 becomes part of a more secure and scalable workflow. This includes SOC2 compliance, audit logs, SAML SSO, SLAs, and advanced analytics. **Best use case:** a fintech or healthcare company developing user-facing portals that must meet strict compliance and security requirements. Here, v0 helps generate the UI fast, while the enterprise-grade Vercel platform ensures safe deployment and access control. ## What do you get with Vercel v0? * Prompt-to-code UI generation using Tailwind CSS and React * Code export for use in your projects * Vercel integration for deployment and preview * No backend, database, or auth logic generation * Best for frontend developers, rapid prototyping, and UI scaffolding ## Comparison: Vercel v0 vs UI Bakery vs Lovable AI vs Bolt AI | Feature / Tool | Vercel v0 | UI Bakery | Bolt AI | Lovable AI | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Pricing | Free (UI only) | Free tier + paid from $4/month | Free tier + paid plans from ~$20/month | Free plan + paid plans from ~$25/month | | Frontend Stack | React + Tailwind | Angular / React (customizable) | React + Tailwind | React | | Backend Support | ❌ | ✅ Built-in logic editor, API & DB | ✅ Node.js, Prisma | ❌ | | Database Integration | ❌ | ✅ SQL/NoSQL, REST, GraphQL | ✅ PostgreSQL, MongoDB | ❌ | | AI Capabilities | Prompt-to-UI (React components) | Prompt-based app gen + low-code tools | Prompt-to-fullstack app | Prompt-to-UI generation | | Code Export | ✅ (Frontend only) | ✅ Fullstack (frontend + backend + DB) | ✅ Fullstack export | ❌ | | Deployment Options | Vercel only | Built-in deploy + self-hosting | GitHub/manual deploy | ❌ | | Ease of Use | Developer-focused | Visual builder with code customization | Dev-oriented, more complex | Designer-friendly, no-code | | Best For | Frontend devs, UI prototyping | Enterprise apps, internal tools | Startup builders, MVPs | Designers, PMs with no coding background | ## Final thoughts * Vercel v0 will be an ideal choice if you’re a developer working on Next.js apps and want to generate high-quality components quickly. * If you need backend support, database integration, or full app
